text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is an interview for a racing 
magazine. Chrono Genesis is set to have a 
dialogue with a certain Umamusume, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it was no wonder. After all, the 
person they were interviewing was—
—Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you today. ...I've been 
looking forward to this day, Chrono-kun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli. Three consecutive Grand 
Prix victories, Japan's first challenge at 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe... A 
legendary Umamusume who built countless 
milestones."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she has already retired from active 
racing, she now supports Umamusume chasing 
their dreams. Many are deeply inspired by 
her diligent and tireless efforts.
choice_data_list:
Likewise, I look forward to working with 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
P... Please treat me well. To be able to 
talk with someone who achieved such 
historic greatness... It's... truly an 
honor.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli and I are old friends. When 
I asked, she gladly accepted."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A discussion with an up-and-coming 
Umamusume making waves right now... Fufu, 
it sounds like it will be very fruitful.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—It's called 'Three-Pronged Training.' 
Changing one's environment tempers both 
body and mind. ...It forms the very core 
of my philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I see...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible... To hear such a valuable 
story directly from the person 
herself...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I'd love to just keep listening, but... 
since it's a discussion, shouldn't I voice 
my opinion too...? B-But even if my words 
end up in the article...)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that's a wonderful 
racing outfit. Its refined design carries 
such a sense of nobility... Did you have a 
particular vision for it?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
*Gasp*... Y-Yes! I gave... a lot of 
thought to the accessory designs.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...It's a racing outfit made just for me, 
so... I really want to make it special...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The reverence Umamusume hold for 
their Racewear... That hasn't changed, 
then or now.
choice_data_list:
(Great! She's getting back to her usual 
self!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Chrono Genesis, gradually 
relaxing, proceeded with the interview...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, chatting with the youth is always so 
stimulating. ...Now, would you answer one 
last question for me?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"What is it that you wish to accomplish in 
this world?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wh-What I want to accomplish...? 
That is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I do have a dream... but in front of this 
person, s-such an audacious thing...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I completely understand how she feels. 
It's precisely because her opponent is 
such a great Umamusume that she's feeling 
intimidated...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Still, her feelings toward racing are by 
no means light.”
choice_data_list:
(Right, that's what I wished for on my 
Racewear...!)

(Right, that's what I wished for on my 
Racewear...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. Back when I first... slipped my 
arms through the sleeves of my racing 
racewear—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...So this is my Racewear.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Together with this outfit... will I be 
able to stand shoulder to shoulder with 
the legendary Umamusume of the past?"
choice_data_list: If it's you, I know you can do it!
If it's you, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...It's very reassuring to hear you say 
that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In that case... I must step forward. New 
records, fierce battles with rivals... It 
is through challenges that history is 
etched into eternity.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To forge history like never before... I 
will keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I have to take a step forward...! Even in 
front of Speed Symboli-san... I will...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...What I wish to accomplish is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"It's to carve my name into history, just 
like you!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For example... the unprecedented feat of 
winning four consecutive Grand Prix races!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to create a legacy, a history that 
will be talked about for generations to 
come.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: This is my... reason to run...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I offer my heartfelt blessings to your 
challenge. For in any era, dreams never 
truly end.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli-san...! Th-Thank you so 
much!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Trainer. ...You were watching me, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It might only be a small step, but... I 
finally took it!
choice_data_list: It's gonna make for a fantastic article!
I'm sure it'll make a fantastic article!

It's precisely because you had feelings 
you couldn't compromise on.

It's precisely because you had feelings 
you couldn't compromise on.

text_block_list.text:

It's precisely because you had feelings

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you think so...? I'd be really happy 
if everyone read it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, when their interview article was 
published, the public's reception was—
choice_data_list: Everyone was cheering you on, Chrono!
Everyone was cheering you on, Chrono!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. What a relief... I will definitely 
live up to everyone's expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...It was truly a wonderful opportunity. 
It helped me remember the vow I made to my 
Racewear."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I will carve my very existence into the 
history of racing. Alongside this racing 
silks!
